summary:
The Dylan Amsterdam, Member of The Leading Hotels of the World is amsterdam's best kept secret!

Enchants, indulges and delights each guest that enters through its historical gate., founded in 1999. Type: private company. About 62 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: A small luxury boutique hotel in canal houses on Amsterdam's Keizersgracht, staffed largely by hotel-school graduates; not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: A boutique hotel of about 62 people on LinkedIn, set in historic Keizersgracht canal houses around a courtyard.
Staff mostly come from Hotelschool The Hague, University of Amsterdam and NHL Stenden, studying hospitality management and international studies.
Most staff work in operations, guest service, business development, finance and HR.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level finance role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in 1999 and privately held, with 62 employees listed on LinkedIn.

worth_knowing.text: The open finance role averaged 164 LinkedIn applicants, so it is very competitive.
